Package net.boricj.bft.dwarf

Record Class DwarfLineInfo.DwarfLineRow

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
net.boricj.bft.dwarf.DwarfLineInfo.DwarfLineRow
Record Components:
address - machine address for this row
file - one-based file index
line - source line number
column - source column number
isStatement - statement marker state
basicBlock - basic-block start marker
endSequence - end-of-sequence marker
prologueEnd - function prologue end marker
epilogueBegin - function epilogue start marker
isa - instruction-set architecture discriminator
discriminator - path discriminator value
Enclosing class:
DwarfLineInfo
public static record DwarfLineInfo.DwarfLineRow(long address, long file, long line, long column, boolean isStatement, boolean basicBlock, boolean endSequence, boolean prologueEnd, boolean epilogueBegin, long isa, long discriminator) extends Record
One decoded line-table row emitted by the line-state machine.

      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with '=='.
